## Path pattern

Provide a generalized path. Mask your username and private folder names, for example:

`~/Library/Caches/com.example.app/...`

## Suspected source app or tool


## What appears to create it?


## Typical contents

List extensions or generic filenames only. Do not upload the contents themselves.

## Reproducibility evidence

Explain whether the data can be recreated, rebuilt, or downloaded again, and how you verified that.

## Additional context

Do not include private filenames, full personal paths, credentials, customer data, project data, or an unredacted scan report.
